# BagUI

> BagUI is an open-source shadcn/ui registry with production-ready components, blocks, templates, and animations for React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Copy, customize, and build faster.

## About
BagUI provides a curated collection of high-quality, accessible components and blocks built on top of shadcn/ui, designed for developers who want to ship faster without sacrificing quality.

## Tech Stack
- React
- Next.js
- Tailwind CSS
- TypeScript
- shadcn/ui

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.bagui.pro)
- [Components](https://www.bagui.pro/components)
- [Blocks](https://www.bagui.pro/blocks)
- [Documentation](https://www.bagui.pro/docs)

## Usage
Components can be installed via the shadcn/ui CLI by pointing to the BagUI registry.
